review: The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu is a complex Identity, which combines many properties within itself. However, the most stable and yielding playstyle for him is to rely on his abilities to interact with the Heishou packs. At the moment of the review there are only 5 Heishou IDs but he will become even more stronger with the addition of them. But what are his interactions? Is there anything to look for inside this block of text of an ID? Let’s find out through his kit. We will start with his Passives, and there are two of them. Let’s talk about how his first and ALWAYS active Passive interacts with his allies: - The first part heals SP for allies that entered the battlefield and makes them use EXTRA Skill 1 on combat start.
